announcements.headline: Strategic acquisitions and strong organic growth for Medical Solutions
announcements.insight: Nolato acquires Dutch Unitron to strengthen its customer offering in Medical Solutions. This follows recent leadership appointments and a divestment, indicating active portfolio management.

announcements.headline: Nolato appoints Cecilia Hellner Head of Engineered Solutions
announcements.insight: Nolato appoints Cecilia Hellner as Head of Engineered Solutions. This follows recent CEO appointment, acquisition and divestment actions.

announcements.headline: Nolato acquires Dutch Unitron – strengthens the total customer offering in the Medical Solutions business area
announcements.insight: The acquisition strengthens the Medical Solutions business area, following recent leadership changes and a Romanian divestment. This expands the customer offering after earlier growth reports.

announcements.headline: Growth for both business areas and strong financial position
announcements.insight: Strong financial position follows the divestment of Romanian operations in June. This supports the new CEO's appointment in May.

announcements.headline: Nolato divests its Romanian operations
announcements.insight: Nolato divests its Romanian operations. This follows the appointment of a new CEO in May, suggesting strategic restructuring under fresh leadership.

announcements.headline: Nolato appoints Anders Björklund as new President and CEO
announcements.insight: Anders Björklund is appointed President and CEO. This leadership change may influence future strategic direction and governance for shareholders.
